response.text: {"question":"Does SEBI consider voice‑to‑text and chatbot systems that analyze unstructured text as AI/ML systems subject to the Annexure B requirements?","answer":"Yes, SEBI includes voice‑to‑text, text‑to‑intelligence, robo‑chat bots and big‑data intelligence‑gathering tools that process unstructured data under the AI/ML systems definition in Annexure B.","answerable":true}
